name: Indalpine
summary: Indalpine, sold under the brand name Upstène, is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) that was briefly marketed as an antidepressant for treatment of depression. It was marketed in France and a few other European countries.

pharmacology.text: Indalpine is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) and antihistamine.

uses.text: Indalpine, sold under the brand name Upstène, is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) that was briefly marketed as an antidepressant for treatment of depression. It was marketed in France and a few other European countries. Indalpine was invented by 1977 and was introduced for medical use in France in 1983.
